name: msg_main_ebard
description: Madison Square Garden main wide camera with a basketball-trained detector (E-BARD BODD_yolov8n). No court polygon: the detector already ignores the crowd, and the polygon fitted for COCO clips real players. Tracker settings are for the trackers-package ByteTrack, which beat sv-bytetrack, OC-SORT and BoT-SORT on this footage. [landmarks annotated on S_N3_HD frame 3329]
